Creates a new content page (admin only), as multipart/form-data so the featured image can be uploaded in the same request. - `image` (file, optional) — JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 5MB. Leave empty to create without an image; it can be added later via 'Update page image'.
Returns a paginated list of pages (admin only).

Creates a post owned by the authenticated user, as multipart/form-data so images and/or videos can be attached in the same request — there is no separate 'add media' endpoint. `user_id` is always taken from the authenticated user, never from the body.

**Body (form-data)**
- `title` (string, optional)
- `content` (string, optional)
- `status` (enum, optional, default `draft`) — one of: draft, scheduled, published. `published_at`/`published_by` are set automatically the first time status becomes `published` (`published_by` is whoever made this call, which may be an admin publishing on the owner's behalf).
- `scheduled_at` (datetime, required when status is `scheduled`)
- `latitude` / `longitude` (float, optional, provide both together) — WGS84 coordinates of where the post was created; stored as a PostGIS point.
- `location_name` (string, optional) — human-readable place name. If omitted and latitude/longitude are given, it's auto-filled via reverse geocoding (taluk, district, state) against imported geography data; left null if nothing matches. Provide it explicitly to override or to set a place name without geocoding.
- `images` (file[], optional) — JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 5MB each
- `videos` (file[], optional) — MP4/MOV/WebM, max 100MB each
- `video_thumbnails` (file[], required if `videos` is set) — one cover image per video, matched by position

formdata.description: Optional. Manual place name; overrides the automatic reverse-geocode fallback derived from latitude/longitude.
Optional. One or more image files (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 5MB each)
Optional. One or more video files (MP4/MOV/WebM, max 100MB each)
Required if 'videos' is set. One cover-image file per video, in the same order (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 5MB each)

request.description: Returns a paginated list of non-deleted posts. Each item includes the resolved author and its media list (same shape as 'Get post'), batched in a couple of extra queries rather than one per post. Each item also includes likes_count, comments_count, and shares_count, batched per page.

Retrieves a single post by ID, with the author (id, name, profile_image_url) resolved and its media list embedded, so a client can render a post without extra calls. Also includes likes_count, comments_count (all levels, not just top-level threads) and shares_count.

Updates a post, as multipart/form-data. Only the owner (or an admin) may update it. Only the fields included are changed. Any images/videos included are appended to the post's existing media (this endpoint never removes media, use 'Delete post media' for that).

**Body (form-data)** — same optional fields as Create post (including `latitude`/`longitude`, which re-run the reverse-geocode fallback for `location_name` unless you also pass `location_name` explicitly). Publishing here (status becomes `published`) also sets `published_by` to whoever made this call. `title` and `location_name` can also be changed independently of media/coordinates.

formdata.description: Optional. Set/override the place name directly, independent of latitude/longitude.
Optional. One or more additional image files to append
Optional. One or more additional video files to append
Required if 'videos' is set. One cover-image file per video, in the same order

**Body (json, optional)**
- `utm_source` (string, optional) — where the share came from (e.g. whatsapp, facebook, copy_link), for attribution. Omit the body entirely if not tracking this.

request.description: Admin only. Uploads a Survey of India Kerala Administrative Boundary Database ZIP, extracts KERALA_STATE_BDY/KERALA_DISTRICT_BDY/KERALA_SUBDISTRICT_BDY shapefiles, reprojects to EPSG:4326 and upserts gis_states/gis_districts/gis_taluks keyed by LGD code.
Public. Returns a paginated list of GIS states.
Public. Returns a paginated list of GIS districts belonging to a state. 404 if the state does not exist.
Public. Returns a paginated list of GIS taluks belonging to a district. 404 if the district does not exist.
Authenticated. Resolves the state, district, and taluk containing the given coordinates via PostGIS spatial lookup. 404 if no boundary matches.
